music.generatedLyrics:
[Intro]

[Hook]
Windows down, paws on the dash
Summer sun, making a splash
Tail flicking to the beat
Feeling that asphalt heat

[Verse]
Old Honda, dusty and blue
Tuna treats, a bay view
Staring at a bird or two
Searching for something new
Fur against the vinyl seat
Life is bittersweet and sweet

[Chorus]
Traveler with amber eyes
Chasing shadows, orange skies
Four paws on the floor
Don't need a map anymore
Purr of the motor
Scent of the clover
Summer isn't over

[Verse]
Gas stops at half-past nine
Looking at the neon sign
Stretch like a crescent moon
Reach the ocean fairly soon
Boxes piled in the back
Snacks in a paper sack

[Pre-Chorus]
The world is wide and green
The best I've ever seen
With my best friend by my side
Enjoying the bumpy ride

[Chorus]
Traveler with amber eyes
Chasing shadows, orange skies
Four paws on the floor
Don't need a map anymore
Purr of the motor
Scent of the clover
Summer isn't over

[Bridge]
No collars, just open space
Wind across your face
Nap in the golden light
Everything is alright
Meow at passing trucks
We don't care about luck

[Verse]
Sand in your fuzzy fur
Hear that happy motor purr
Pink tint on your nose
Strike a little pose
Sunset on every street
Journey is complete

[Chorus]
Traveler with amber eyes
Chasing shadows, orange skies
Four paws on the floor
Don't need a map anymore
Purr of the motor
Scent of the clover
Summer isn't over

[Post-Chorus]
Summer isn't over
Scent of the clover
Purr of the motor
Yeah, we're taking over

[Outro]
